snippet.title: Object Impermanence - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
In this world, vision defines reality, if you can’t see it, it doesn’t exist.

Play the Object Impermanence demo now! Explore a desolate planet adrift in the void, master the laws of a decaying reality, and discover the secrets hidden within ruins that shift the moment you blink.

Demo Launch: June 12th at 7:00 PM CEST
PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4330960/Object_Impermanence_Demo/

Developed by Slugware with an original score by Jamal Green

Full Launch: Q3-Q4 2026.

#ObjectImpermanence  #PuzzleGame #IndieGame #SteamNextFest
